**Answer**

The beach is **Panama City Beach** (Florida).

- **Alcohol policy**: Alcohol is allowed on the sandy beaches year‑round **except** for the month of **March** (March 1–31).  

**Evidence**

- Visit Panama City Beach’s “Know Before You Go” guide states: “Alcohol is **not permitted** on the sandy beaches from **March 1–31**.” (visitpanamacitybeach.com)  

Thus, Panama City Beach meets the criterion of allowing alcohol consumption year‑round, with a prohibition only during March.

steps.text:
The beach is **Panama City Beach (on the sandy Gulf Coast of Florida)**.  

It permits alcohol on the beach throughout the year, but the beach ordinance explicitly prohibits any alcohol consumption on the sandy beaches during March 1–31.  

**Source**  
- “Know Before You Go Guide” – Visit Panama City Beach: *“Alcohol is not permitted on the sandy beaches from March 1–31.”* (https://www.visitpanamacitybeach.com/stay-pcb-current/knowbeforeyougo/)
